fatal_weakness: Perfect AUC=1.000 across four independent compartments in n=8 is statistically implausible unless the score is partially derived from or correlated with the treatment label itself, suggesting leakage or circular feature selection.
held_data_test: Permute W8-vs-baseline labels 1000x within subject and recompute compartment-wise IFN/APC AUCs; also run leave-one-subject-out AUC and report the empirical null distribution and per-fold AUC variance.
kill_result: If permuted null AUCs frequently reach >=0.95 or LOSO AUC drops below 0.75 with high variance, the perfect AUCs reflect small-n overfitting/leakage rather than a real state.

fatal_weakness: W8 samples may have been processed, sequenced, or captured in a different batch/run than baselines, so the IFN/APC signal could be a technical batch effect masquerading as treatment biology.
held_data_test: Regress the locked_signed_score on sequencing batch, capture date, 10x lane, ambient RNA fraction, and %mito with timepoint as covariate; recompute AUC after residualizing on technical covariates only (no biology).
kill_result: If technical-only residualization collapses AUC to <0.7 or batch explains >50% of score variance, the W8 state is a processing artifact.

fatal_weakness: Cross-compartmental IFN/APC elevation may reflect shifts in cell-type composition (e.g., more monocytes, fewer naive T) at W8 rather than a true within-cell transcriptional state.
held_data_test: Recompute IFN/APC scores using only fine-grained subtype-matched cells (down-sampled to equal subtype proportions per sample) and report AUC; additionally test whether subtype fractions alone predict W8 at AUC>=0.9.
kill_result: If composition-matched AUC falls below 0.8 or subtype fractions alone reach AUC>=0.9, the signal is a compositional shift, not a remodeling state.

fatal_weakness: An incidental viral or inflammatory exposure concurrent with W8 sampling could drive a generic type-I IFN response indistinguishable from a treatment-induced state, especially if W8 visits cluster in time.
held_data_test: Score samples for ISG-core (IFI6, ISG15, MX1, OAS1) versus APC/MHC-II module separately, check temporal clustering of W8 draws, and test whether residualizing on a generic viral-ISG signature collapses the locked score.
kill_result: If APC component vanishes after ISG-core residualization or W8 draws cluster in calendar time with elevated ISG-core, the lead is confounded by incidental infection.

fatal_weakness: The claim of an integrated IFN/STAT/glycolysis remodeling state is undertested; tied AUCs at 0.950 may reflect any single dominant axis, with glycolysis riding passively on IFN.
held_data_test: Compute partial AUC of delta_glycolysis after residualizing on delta_IFN_APC and delta_stat1_axis at the per-cell level, and conversely; also test single-cell correlation of glycolysis vs STAT1 within W8 cells per compartment.
kill_result: If glycolysis AUC drops to chance after IFN/STAT residualization and within-cell correlations are near zero, glycolysis is not part of an integrated state and the 'broader remodeling' framing is unsupported.
